limitations: This addendum executes static checkers only; runtime findings are cross-referenced from immutable LOCAL-VERIFY-002.
The results are version-scoped to mypy 2.3.1 and Pyright 1.1.414 with Python target 3.14.
Pyright standard acceptance is not equivalent to strict acceptance or runtime correctness.
Pyright output contains nondeterministic wall-clock and duration measurements; semantic repeat comparison excludes only those measurements.

minimized_counterexamples.finding: typing.GenericAlias is unavailable and GenericAlias[...] is rejected.
Packed[int, ...] and Packed[...] are runtime-accepted in prior evidence but statically rejected here.
The ignore makes checkers reveal C2 while prior native execution constructs C.

result_summary.dataclass_bare_instance: mypy 2.3.1 reproduces var-annotated; Pyright standard accepts with Unknown and strict rejects Unknown.
result_summary.dataclass_factory_mismatch: Both reject without suppression; suppression leaves the prior native runtime C-versus-C2 defect.
result_summary.sound_alternatives: DC04, DC05 and DC06 pass both modes of both checkers.
result_summary.types_genericalias_static_utility: Both reject calling the runtime alias and infer Any/Unknown for its result.
result_summary.typevartuple_literal_ellipsis: Both reject the tested user-defined Generic[*Ts] forms.
